patent.eventDescription: One delivered patent snapshot ($5 per 1,000 rows; row keys id, title, snippet, inventor, assignee, priority_date, filing_date, publication_date, grant_date, content_hash, fetched_at). No start fee; proxy and compute included. Filters, duplicates, excluded rows and failures without delivered rows are free. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (Apify run option, not input). Nested data included; partial errors retain paid rows already delivered. Inspect free SUMMARY for page limits and source errors.
